macros.name: blockquote
macros.doc: This command determines the length of the ⟨text⟩. If the length exceeds a certain threshold, the ⟨text⟩ will be typeset in display mode, i. e., as a block quotation.

macros.name: closeautoquote
macros.doc: Closes a nestable quotation.

macros.name: closeinnerquote
macros.doc: Closes an inner quotation.

macros.name: DeclareAutoPunct
macros.doc: This command defines the punctuation marks to be considered by the quotation commands as they scan ahead for punctuation.

macros.name: DeleteQuotes
macros.doc: Disables and deallocates all active quotes, i.e. performs a complete reset of all allocated characters so that they may be newly defined.

macros.name: DisableQuotes
macros.doc: Disables all active quotes by restoring the original category codes and definitions of all allocated characters.

macros.name: EnableQuotes
macros.doc: Enables all active quotes by redefining the allocated characters and making them active.

macros.name: enquote
macros.doc: Depending on the nesting level, it will toggle between outer and inner quotation marks with plain and nested quotations.

macros.name: foreignblockcquote
macros.doc: This command combines \blockcquote with \foreignlanguage.

macros.name: foreignblockquote
macros.doc: This command behaves like \foreignquote if the quotation is short. If it exceeds the threshold, it will be wrapped in an otherlanguage* environment which is in turn wrapped in a block quotation environment.

macros.name: foreignquote
macros.doc: This command combines \enquote with \foreignlanguage.

macros.name: foreigntextcquote
macros.doc: This command combines \textcquote with \foreignlanguage.

macros.name: foreigntextquote
macros.doc: This command combines \textquote with \foreignlanguage.

macros.name: hybridblockcquote
macros.doc: This command behaves like \hyphenblockcquote if the quotation is short, and like \foreignblockquote if it is long.

macros.name: hybridblockquote
macros.doc: This command behaves like \hyphenquote if the quotation is short. If it exceeds the threshold, the command behaves like \foreignblockquote.

macros.name: hyphenblockcquote
macros.doc: This command combines \blockcquote with the hyphenrules environment.

macros.name: hyphenblockquote
macros.doc: This command behaves like \hyphenquote if the quotation is short. If it exceeds the threshold, it will be wrapped in a hyphenrules environment which is in turn wrapped in a block quotation environment.

macros.name: hyphenquote
macros.doc: This command combines \enquote with the hyphenrules environment, that is, it merely switches hyphenation patterns.

macros.name: hyphentextcquote
macros.doc: This command combines \textcquote with the hyphenrules environment.

macros.name: hyphentextquote
macros.doc: This command combines \textquote with the hyphenrules environment.

macros.name: ifblockquote
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ in all block and display quotations, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifpunct
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if preceeded by any punctuation mark, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifpunctmark
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if preceeded by the punctuation mark ⟨character⟩, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifterm
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if preceeded by a terminal punctuation mark (period, exclamation mark, or question mark), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iftextpunct
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨text⟩ ends with any punctuation mark, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iftextpunctmark
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨text⟩ ends with the punctuation mark ⟨character⟩, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iftextterm
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨text⟩ ends with a terminal punctuation mark (period, exclamation mark, or question mark), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: initiquote
macros.doc: Executes the inner initialization hook.

macros.name: initoquote
macros.doc: Executes the outer initialization hook.

macros.name: MakeAutoQuote
macros.doc: All active quotes defined with \MakeAutoQuote work like \enquote.

macros.name: MakeBlockQuote
macros.doc: \MakeBlockQuote defines active quotes which will set quotations inline or as a separate paragraph, depending on their length.

macros.name: MakeHybridBlockQuote
macros.doc: The active quotes defined with this command are similar in concept and function to \hybridblockquote.

macros.name: MakeOuterQuote
macros.doc: \MakeOuterQuote and \MakeInnerQuote define active quotes which print outer and inner quotation marks.

macros.name: mkblockquote
macros.doc: The \mkblockquote hook controls the layout of all block quotations.

macros.name: mkccitation
macros.doc: The default behavior of this command is to separate the citation from the preceding text by an interword space.

macros.name: mkcitation
macros.doc: All facilities which take a ⟨cite⟩ argument will pass it to the \mkcitation hook, which may be redefined to format the citation.

macros.name: mkenddispquote
macros.doc: By default, \mkenddispquote adds the ⟨punct⟩ argument as well as the ⟨cite⟩ argument or the citation code at the very end of the quotation.

macros.name: mktextquote
macros.doc: The \mktextquote hook controls the layout of all text quotations.

macros.name: openautoquote
macros.doc: Opens a nestable quotation.

macros.name: SetBlockEnvironment
macros.doc: \SetBlockEnvironment specifies the environment used for block and display quotations.

macros.name: SetBlockThreshold
macros.doc: defines the number of lines or words the block quotation facilities use as a threshold when determining whether a quotation should be typeset in inline or in display mode.

macros.name: SetCiteCommand
macros.doc: The argument to \SetCiteCommand specifies a replacement for \cite which will be used by all integrated quotation facilities to handle citations.

macros.name: setquotestyle
macros.doc: The regular form of this command selects a quote style and disables multilingual support.

macros.name: textciquote
macros.doc: Prints the closing inner quotation mark.

macros.name: textcoquote
macros.doc: Prints the closing outer quotation mark.

macros.name: textdel
macros.doc: By default, \textdel will output two square brackets.

macros.name: textelp
macros.doc: When used with an empty ⟨text⟩ argument, this command prints an ellipsis symbol to indicate the omission of material from the quoted material.

macros.name: textins
macros.doc: By default, \textins will enclose the ⟨text⟩ added to the quoted material in square brackets.

macros.name: textmiquote
macros.doc: Prints the middle inner quotation mark.

macros.name: textmoquote
macros.doc: Prints the middle outer quotation mark.

macros.name: textoiquote
macros.doc: Prints the opening inner quotation mark.

macros.name: textooquote
macros.doc: Prints the opening outer quotation mark of the currently active quote style.

macros.name: unspace
macros.doc: Removes preceding whitespace, i. e., removes all skips and penalties from the end of the current horizontal list.

macros.name: VerbatimQuotes
macros.doc: Switches to verbatim active quotes.

envs.name: foreigndisplaycquote
envs.doc: This environment combines displaycquote with otherlanguage*.

envs.name: foreigndisplayquote
envs.doc: This environment combines displayquote with otherlanguage*.

envs.name: hyphendisplaycquote
envs.doc: This environment combines displaycquote with hyphenrules.

envs.name: hyphendisplayquote
envs.doc: This environment combines displayquote with hyphenrules.
